title: MED+250 privileged credential rotation approval
summary: Owner-ready approval for the completed credential rotation. The security owner must review the final redacted receipt, dependency coverage, revocation proof, least-privilege checks and residual-material scan before signing.

checks.name: Completed deployment receipt
checks.detail: The paired rotation deployment receipt remains pending and therefore cannot yet support accountable security approval.

checks.name: All exposed credential classes covered
checks.detail: The security owner must confirm the private inventory covers every exposed Supabase secret API, database and personal management credential and every downstream copy.

checks.name: Old access eliminated
checks.detail: The signed decision must confirm every replaced credential is revoked, no former operation succeeds, and no uncontrolled residual copy remains usable.

checks.name: Replacement access is sufficient and bounded
checks.detail: The signed decision must confirm replacement access supports required production operations without granting broader capability than the approved role.

checks.name: Shared applications remain healthy
checks.detail: The owner must confirm the shared-project rotation caused no unresolved outage, data loss, scheduled-job failure or authentication regression in MED+250 or another dependent application.

checks.name: Named security-owner signature
checks.detail: The accountable security owner has not yet recorded the final decision, conditions, named approver, role and timezone-qualified approval timestamp.

completion_instructions: Complete and strictly validate the paired deployment receipt.
Review the private inventory, shared-project impact, revocation proof, least-privilege checks and residual-material scan.
Record any lawful operating conditions or required follow-up without exposing credential information.
Confirm the review digest still matches, set every check to passed, set decision to approved, add the named approver, role and timestamp, and set status to complete.
Validate the completed approval strictly and add it to the launch registry only with its exact SHA-256 digest.
